EnqueueBlocking(T, CancellationToken)

Adds an item to the queue, blocking if the queue is full until space becomes available or the operation is canceled.

public void EnqueueBlocking(T item, CancellationToken ct)

Parameters

item T

The item to add to the queue.

ct CancellationToken

A System.Threading.CancellationToken that can be used to cancel the operation.

Remarks

This method blocks the calling thread if the queue is full, waiting until space becomes available. Ensure that the ct token is monitored to avoid indefinite blocking in scenarios if cancellation is required.
